commit_message: Box managed resource config and fix test fixture
pr_title: GameEngine: derive managed GGUF representation from file contents
pr_body:
## Summary

- derive Managed Local GGUF representation from file metadata and tensor descriptors rather than filename markers
- preserve a deterministic path-independent exact descriptor for mixed/custom tensor representations and require it for managed Benchmark Campaign candidates
- keep legacy registry JSON readable while requiring one re-registration before legacy filename-derived entries become benchmark eligible
- keep GGUF parsing on the setup worker and avoid model payload reads
- box the managed resource-worker configuration after the added identity field crossed Clippy's enum-size threshold
- complete the managed native-model worker test fixture
- seed a feature-gated `3.69bpw` GGUF visual fixture so candidate selection and exact representation can be inspected

## Scope

Managed Local AI GGUF registration and ADR 0156 Benchmark Campaign representation identity only.
